findings.title: Dangling 'code_revision' references in public row text
findings.evidence: 7 new rows say '(see code_revision)' or 'as listed in code_revision' (cribl x2, decision-king, joey-1, saif-4b, sors-2b, wemm-jev), but no published new row has a code_revision field. ENTRIES.json has one, and the builder drops it. Saif: 'The extreme internal construction cap is disclosed in code_revision.' points readers to text they cannot see. The same pattern exists in 8 live v1.8.0 rows that passed review (e.g. elephant-1, mammoth-1, knowline-31b-gen1), so it is not new to this round.
findings.requested_change: Follow-up, or now if the lead prefers: publish code_revision for these rows (as 5 v1.8.0 rows do), or drop the pointers. At minimum, rewrite or remove the Saif sentence.

findings.title: decide-1.1 log-style phrases
findings.evidence: endpoint_condition: 'from the measurement client with the customer's own key', '...exposure of 1,200 sealed items to provider decide (proxy aws) logged before the first request (pre-registration review)'. cost.basis: 'Frozen pricing module validates the operator standard launch list price.' Readable and with house precedent ('to provider `scira`' in 18 live rows), but stilted.
findings.requested_change: Optional rewording, e.g. 'with the evaluation client's own API key'; 'all 1,200 sealed items were logged as exposed to decide.sh (served via AWS) before the first request'; 'The frozen pricing module checks this against the operator's standard launch list price.'

findings.title: Residual internal-process jargon (not on the banned list)
findings.evidence: sors-2b: 'at the time of drafting', 'An earlier internally measured export'. saif-4b: 'eligible for intake with the non-commercial flag'. decision-king: 'record-only class C deviation'. 'TTL-fit admitted ...' (5 rows), 'pair-fit' (cribl x2), wemm 'accepted root pricing reference', and the redundant 'in this intake (our own intake)' (7 rows; 21 live precedents).
findings.requested_change: Optional polish: 'at publication', 'an earlier unpublished measurement', drop 'eligible for intake ...', 'deviation' without 'class C', 'pre-run time check' instead of TTL-fit.
